Name: Fitter Clint
Author: Lavendarjosh
Description:
[b]For a hardworking blacksmith, Clint seemed to be awfully chubby, so I gave his sprites a  little makeover. He's a bit taller, slimmer, and has slightly redder hair and slightly darker eyes. And he swapped his blue jeans for some more sooty ones.

Fitter Clint is now available for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/151924203]Morghoula[/url] for providing the files!

The new sprites are based on and are meant to be used with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url] made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for a consistent look. It's not required, though.
To install, simply drag the Clint.xnb from the .zip into your [b]*\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters folder[/b]. Make sure to backup your old file beforehand, in case you want chubby Clint back.

I also recommend a portrait that make him less...round. Personally, I use DCBurger's Portrait Mod and modeled the sprite with those in mind. Enjoy.[/b]
